title: Azure Linux repo-tests --summary-json output (v1)
description: Companion schema for the JSON file written by the pytest --summary-json hook in utils/pytest_plugin.py. The hook emits one file per pytest invocation containing every classified known-violations record across all tests; CI consumers can gate on real_fails / known_violations / stale without re-parsing pytest output. Schema version is pinned by SUMMARY_JSON_SCHEMA_VERSION in utils/pytest_plugin.py and validated structurally by tests/unit/test_known_violations.py via this file.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Bump in lockstep with SUMMARY_JSON_SCHEMA_VERSION; mismatched versions must be rejected by consumers so a silent shape drift never goes unnoticed.

exit_status.description: The pytest exit code returned by the run that produced this summary. Standard pytest exit codes: 0 = all passed, 1 = test failures, 2 = interrupted, 3 = internal error, 4 = usage error, 5 = no tests collected.

records.description: One record per (test_nodeid, arch, source_label) tuple emitted by a test that classified known-violations.

test_nodeid.description: The pytest nodeid of the test that produced this record (e.g. cases/test_repoclosure_base_plus_sdk_full.py::test_repoclosure_base_plus_sdk_full[x86_64]).

arch.description: The architecture the test ran for.

source_label.description: Identifier the test passed for the slice of findings that produced these verdicts (e.g. 'runtime-missing', 'buildtime-missing', 'duplicate-subpackage'). Lets a CI consumer scope its gating per source.

real_fails.description: Verdicts the test treated as a hard fail (consumer not in allowlist, or observed values exceed listed values).

known_violations.description: Verdicts the test treated as XFAIL (consumer in allowlist and observed values are a subset of the listed values).

stale.description: Stale-entry signals: consumer listed but absent on this arch (kind=stale-consumer), or a listed value never appeared in any finding for the consumer (kind=stale-dep).

key.description: String form of the test-specific finding key (e.g. NEVRA for repoclosure, binary name for duplicate-subpackage).

consumer.description: The allowlist consumer-name extracted from the finding key.

observed.description: Sorted, deduplicated list of value-strings observed for this finding.

listed.description: Sorted, deduplicated list of value-strings the allowlist permits for this consumer, OR null when no allowlist entry exists for the consumer (the unlisted-consumer real-fail branch).

reason.description: (Optional, ST2) free-text rationale carried over from the allowlist entry. Omitted when absent.

issue.description: (Optional, ST2) tracking link (URL or shorthand like 'AB#12345') carried over from the allowlist entry. Omitted when absent.

listed_dep.description: For kind=stale-dep, the listed value-string that never appeared in any finding for the consumer. Null for kind=stale-consumer.
